description_en: Retrieves historical data reports for one or more skill groups in a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport获取指定实例下的一个或多个技能组的历史数据报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-historical-skill-group-report --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --skill-group-id-list '["skillgroup1@ccc-test","skillgroup2@ccc-test2"]' --start-time 1532448000000 --end-time 1532707199000 --instance-id ccc-test --media-type VIDEO --summarize-by-instance-id true --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of skill group IDs to query. The value is a character string in the JSON array format, where each array element is a skill group ID. This parameter is optional. Default value: empty. An empty value indicates that all skill groups in the current paging are queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的技能组ID列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素为技能组ID，非必填，默认为空，表示查询当前分页下的所有技能组
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list

parameters.help_en: The start time of the historical data to retrieve. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. Default value: 00:00:00 on the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time. The statistical time precision is in hours. The start time is rounded down to the nearest hour, and the interval is closed
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，最早为当前时间往前180天，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the historical data to retrieve. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. Default value: the current time. The statistical time precision is in hours. The end time is rounded up to the nearest hour, and the interval is open. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the aligned time range is [11:00:00, 12:00:00), which means greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当前时间，统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00, 12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The media type. Default value: Audio. Valid values: Audio, Chat, and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to aggregate data by instance ID
parameters.name: summarize_by_instance_id

CallsAbandoned.description_en: The number of abandoned calls. Calculation formula: CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_en: The number of calls abandoned in queue, which refers to the number of calls hung up by customers while waiting in the queue after entering it
CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_zh: 队列放弃量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInRing.description_en: The number of calls abandoned during ringing, which refers to the number of calls hung up by customers while the agent is ringing
CallsAbandonedInRing.description_zh: 振铃放弃量，即坐席振铃中客户挂机的数量

CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_en: The number of attended transfers in, which refers to the number of calls transferred to this skill group from other skill groups through attended transfers. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed in to multiple skill groups at the same time, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed in to. If a call is transferred to this skill group multiple times from other skill groups, each transfer is counted as one. The same rule applies to similar metrics below
CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_zh: 咨询转入量，即由其他技能组发起的咨询转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时迁入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_en: The number of attended transfers out, which refers to the number of calls transferred from this skill group to other skill groups through attended transfers. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_zh: 咨询转出量，即由该技能组发起的咨询转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsBlindTransferIn.description_en: The number of blind transfers in, which refers to the number of calls transferred to this skill group from other skill groups through blind transfers. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed in to multiple skill groups at the same time, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed in to. If a call is transferred to this skill group multiple times from other skill groups, each transfer is counted as one. The same rule applies to similar metrics below
CallsBlindTransferIn.description_zh: 直接转入量，即由其他技能组发起的直接转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时签入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsBlindTransferOut.description_en: The number of blind transfers out, which refers to the number of calls transferred from this skill group to other skill groups through blind transfers. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsBlindTransferOut.description_zh: 直接转出量，即由该技能组发起的直接转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsHandled.description_en: The number of handled calls, which refers to the number of times agents answer calls. If a call is answered by multiple agents after entering the queue each time, it is counted as one
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即坐席应答的次数。一通电话每次进入队列后，若被多个坐席应答，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: The number of held calls, which refers to the number of times calls are put on hold. If a call is put on hold multiple times after entering the queue each time, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的次数。一通电话每次进入队列后，若发生多次通话保持，算一次

CallsOffered.description_en: The number of offered calls, which refers to the number of calls assigned to this skill group, including calls assigned through queues and calls assigned through transfers (attended transfers and blind transfers). Calculation formula: CallsQueued + CallsBlindTransferIn + CallsAttendedTransferIn
CallsOffered.description_zh: 分配量，即分配给该技能组的电话数量，包括通过队列分配的电话数量和通过转接（咨询转接和直接转接）分配的电话数量。计算公式为：CallsQueued+CallsBlindTransferIn+CallsAttentandedTransferIn

CallsOverflow.description_en: The number of overflowed calls, which refers to the number of calls that overflow from the queue or skill group. If a call enters the same queue multiple times and overflows each time, each overflow is counted as one
CallsOverflow.description_zh: 溢出量，即发生队列（技能组）溢出的电话数量。若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次溢出算一次

CallsQueued.description_en: The number of queued calls in inbound scenarios, which refers to the number of calls that enter the queue or skill group. If a call enters the same queue multiple times, each entry is counted as one
CallsQueued.description_zh: 呼入场景进入队列（技能组）的电话数量，若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次进入算一次

CallsQueuingFailed.description_en: The number of failed queue calls, which refers to the number of calls hung up by customers while waiting in the queue after entering it
CallsQueuingFailed.description_zh: 队列失败量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsQueuingOverflow.description_en: The number of calls that overflow from the queue, which refers to calls that overflow while waiting in the IVR queue
CallsQueuingOverflow.description_zh: 队列溢出的通话数量，队列溢出指通话在IVR排队时队列溢出

CallsQueuingTimeout.description_en: The number of calls that time out during the queuing phase
CallsQueuingTimeout.description_zh: 在排队阶段超时的通话数量

CallsRinged.description_en: The number of ringing calls, which refers to the number of calls that trigger agent ringing. If a call is assigned to multiple agents and triggers ringing after entering the queue each time, it is counted as one
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，一通电话每次进入队列后，若分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

CallsTimeout.description_en: The number of timed-out calls, which refers to the number of calls that time out in the queue or skill group. If a call enters the same queue multiple times and times out each time, each timeout is counted as one
CallsTimeout.description_zh: 超时量，即发生队列（技能组）超时的电话数量。若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次超时算一次

HandleRate.description_en: The handle rate. Calculation formula: CallsHandled/CallsOffered. The result may exceed 100% in some cases because handle events and offer events may fall into different time ranges
HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled/CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）
